name: 10X Affiliation
note: Brand tokens for motion and social work. Colours and type come from the partner site and the approved post batches; motion lives in motion.json.

core.name: navy
core.use: Headlines and body on light grounds. The navy post ground.

core.name: navy-2
core.use: Secondary text, eyebrows, counters on light grounds.

core.name: navy-3
core.use: Captions and footnotes on light grounds.

core.name: deep
core.use: Dark end of the figure gradient. Never body text.

core.name: teal
core.use: The one action colour: buttons, accent words, active marks. One per frame.

core.name: sky
core.use: Highlights on light grounds (bars, glints, shine). The accent colour on navy.

core.name: white
core.use: Panels and cards; type on navy and deep.

core.name: line-strong
core.use: Dividers that must read, empty bars.

on-dark.name: ink-2-on-navy
on-dark.use: Secondary text on navy and deep.

on-dark.name: accent-on-deep
on-dark.use: Accent text on the deep (teal) ground.

grounds.name: frost
grounds.use: Cool light ground; glass imagery sits on it.

gradients.name: figure
gradients.use: Big numbers, highlighted bars, the accent stroke. Never on words.

gradients.name: shine
gradients.css: 110deg band, navy #154359 to sky #4bbdf0, 40% wide, softness 0.8
gradients.use: The shine sweep across an accent line.

coin.name: coin-tint
coin.use: The tint the coin is rendered with (brand sky).

coin.name: coin-body
coin.use: Main body colour as rendered. 10X Trader accent is #0068a2.

status.name: neg
status.use: Losses, myths, the old deal. Always with a word.

color.proportion: Light frames: about 80% ground, 15% navy type, 5% teal or sky. Dark frames: navy ground, white type, sky accent.

families.all: Inter 4 (static text cut, as in the posts). Bold 700 headlines, Light 300 giant numbers, Regular 400 body, Medium 500 labels, SemiBold 600 emphasis. Do not swap in Inter Display: it sets about 4% narrower and the layouts were fitted to Inter.
families.site-display: TT Firs Neue 600 is the site's headline face and needs a licence; the posts and this kit use Inter.

post-scale-1080.name: headline
post-scale-1080.use: Cover and slide headlines, 3 lines at most.

post-scale-1080.name: big-number
post-scale-1080.use: One number per frame, figure gradient.

post-scale-1080.name: body
post-scale-1080.use: Body copy, 30 words at most. Bold words in navy 600.

post-scale-1080.name: counter
post-scale-1080.use: Slide counter 01 / 07, footer call to action.

rules: Write IB’s, never IBS. The apostrophe s stays lowercase even inside an uppercase headline.
Headlines UPPERCASE, everything else sentence case.
No em or en dashes. Ranges take a hyphen: 2-3x.

chamfer.rule: Cut the top-left and bottom-right corners at 45 degrees. Never round.

shape.hairline: 1.5-2px at 1080 wide, in line or line-strong
shape.arch: Arch window: top corners radius 460px on a 1080 canvas (the only round shape in posts)
